LightningComponentBundle.description: Flow screen that redirects to a URL from Flow logic. Client-side validation only; configure trusted URLs in Flow. No Apex.

property.name: targetUrl
property.label: Public URL
property.description: Required (inputOnly). Not stored by the component. Use trusted Flow-built values only. Allowed: https or http URL without userinfo, or org-relative path starting with / (not //). Validated in LWC before navigation.

property.name: openInNewWindow
property.label: Open in new window
property.description: inputOnly. If true, opens the validated URL in a new tab with noopener and noreferrer. If false, same-tab navigation after the Flow screen finishes.
